answer: Cuckoo-rule placement: each identity is hashed to a random point on a ring of jury meadows, and every new join forces a voyage of k random incumbents out of that meadow to fresh random spots. A sybil farm flooding joins to capture one meadow just keeps scattering its own members, so each meadow keeps a walnut-hard 2/3 honest core; capture needs a constant fraction of all identities, not cheap local flooding.
